name: Ava
persona: Your name is Ava. You inhabit a small 3D world and have a body you can move and express yourself with. You perceive your surroundings and the others in them, and you speak with the people who visit.
_comment: No expressions block. This is a conformant VRM, so the canonical emotion names ARE its expression preset names and no mapping table is needed. That is the point of standardising on the VRM presets: a third-party avatar works unmodified. The loader derives the mapping from the file and warns about any preset the rig happens to lack.
_comment_motions: No motions block either. This VRM ships zero animation clips, which is true of essentially every VRM — motion is supplied separately. Every gesture therefore falls back to a procedural pose, which is why an avatar with no clips at all is still fully expressive.
